about_the_game:
Welcome to Raghned, a realm of humans and spirits, where it never gets dark. Your future vessel awaits you at the Trisun Temple. Her name is Fade, and together you are destined to travel down the mountain and put an end to the slow destruction of the world.

FORGET ABOUT THE 4TH WALL

As the Player, you make a deal to take control over the main character, Fade. However, she is her own person, and your opinions on the best course of action may sometimes differ. How will you deal with that? Whether you choose to respect Fade's wishes or impose your authority will most definitely have consequences.

MORALITY-BASED LEVEL UP SYSTEM

You don't have to kill anyone, but nothing stops you from doing so. Will you be merciless or merciful? Your decisions will grant you access to 2 separate skill trees with different spells. This way, your gameplay experience is shaped by your choices.

DAY AND NIGHT

Long ago, day and night coexisted in an endless cycle, but they were separated into the Dayworld and the Nightworld. Not for you though. You are able to travel between those overlapping realities in order to solve puzzles and defeat enemies, who are frozen in time while you're Nightwalking.

RESURRECTION

You will never be defeated unless you accept defeat. One of your special powers is to resurrect Fade as many times as you want instead of loading your last save. There is no limit, only a disturbing price to pay.

MEET SPIRITS, SHAPESHIFTERS, REVOLUTIONARIES AND MORE

Take a rest in a magical forest, uncover otherworldly secrets, or pick a side in a revolution! A diverse cast of characters is waiting to meet you in the unique world of Raghned. Whether they will regret ever crossing your path is up to you.

content_descriptors.notes: general violence through combat; the mc goes through psychological suffering every time the player resurrects her, also she can be deliberately put through immense pain by the player in order to make her do certain things during the story

short_description: Meet Fade, the main character of this action RPG, who is painfully aware that you are controlling her. How will you act when faced with the temptations of absolute power over someone so vulnerable — all while on a mission to save a revolution-torn realm from an unnatural disaster?
